title: My Wi-Fi is slow
text: My Wi-Fi is slow or keeps dropping. Diagnose it with your system tools, tell me in one or two sentences what is wrong, and then offer the one fix you would try first.

title: The printer does not print

title: My battery drains fast

title: My computer feels slow
text: My computer feels slow right now. Check the top processes, memory and disk with your system tools and tell me what is using it, then what I can do.
